summary: EC condition S1 (no process effluent, condensate or wash water shall leave the premises at any time) is shown breached on SPCB's own reports: RO/SD/24/212 of 22 October 2024 (bypass from the equalisation tank to the creek at Survey No. 214, discharge running, BOD 1,480 mg/L); RO/SD/26/019 of 3 February 2026 (outfall running, BOD 1,120 mg/L); RO/SD/26/144 of 16 July 2026 (fish kill confirmed, bypass in use). Any discharge breaches S1, so the BOD values are not needed to prove it.
provision: para 7 (clearance granted with conditions); EC No. SEIAA/SD/2024/0117, condition S1
recommendation: Make this the lead of the application. Get certified copies of the three reports, the s.33A direction and show-cause notice, and the results of the samples taken on 16 July 2026.
